headline: Kuura Strand Erupts, Nevish Line Slips as Passage Guns Hold
war_summary: Kuura Strand, silent at the last edition, has erupted: twenty-four events in the day and ten in the past two hours, with five Warden posts standing, one position unclaimed, and Suosalo, Faden Point, Talven and Menneen all in contest. Nevish Line, deadlocked four posts apiece this morning, has slipped to three Warden against five Colonial, though forty-six events across the day and seven in two hours keep Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way the busiest works reported. Callahan's Passage holds at eight Warden posts to two Colonial, the hour's losses running near 1,269 Colonial and 1,298 Warden. Weathered Expanse, whose twenty-seven events led the day, has quieted to three in two hours, with Warden posts now two against seven Colonial. Palantine Berm remains wholly Warden at seven posts, its exchanges cooled to five events in a half-day. Stlican Shelf stands at seven Colonial posts to two Warden; Stonecradle, likewise seven to two, has filled its vacant position. Mooring County reports eleven Warden posts to one Colonial and Viper Pit seven to one. No victor has been declared.
